name: Pod et Marichou
overview: We've all lived a THRILLING love story that swept us away beyond reality. This difficult and complicated story that has made us suffer but that fascinates us, that lets the heart speak and clashes with REASON. This reason ultimately brings us back down to earth and guides us towards the path of tangible happiness. This reason allows us to discover the reality of Love and its constraints, the experience of daily life, life, stability, LOVE... True LOVE.
